name: v2-corexy-linear
review: CoreXY transforms X2 Y1 to motor distances 3 and 1 mm; Z is 0.5 mm. At 80 steps/mm the motor positions are 240, 80 and 40 steps. The Cartesian path length is sqrt(5.25) mm; at 10 mm/s and 100 mm/s^2, the zero-to-zero continuous trapezoid takes 0.32913 s versus 0.32864 s recorded, a 0.15% difference. The Z component remains below its default 5 mm/s speed limit. The calculation does not independently verify discrete pulse timing or physical hardware.
